title: Practical and sturdy
text: Practical and sturdy. This bag is almost the same size as a standard grocery store plastic bag. The handles are short like a grocery bag. . It washes well. I air dry it. The bottom of the bag is gusseted, so it will stand up on its own when filled. I have used it several times and it seems very sturdy. The material is a bit heavier than the other bags i have purchased.
